t: Universal tile ventilator with low profile cowl, for new or existing pitched roofs at high or low level. Suitable for most universal single-lap interlocking roof tiles. Can be used as a terminal for soil vent pipe or most extractor fans with a 110mm diameter pipe adaptor. Guaranteed 20,000mm² free ventilation area for any tile type or profile. With lightweight lead alternative 'Aluflash' flashing.
